pages.title: A vessel of power
pages.text: After defeating the Herald of Death a Heart of Death remains: a vessel of the Beyond’s power.$(br2)Absorbing it grants the ability “$(l:beginning/energy_beyond)Energy of the Beyond$(/l)”. It is more than a trophy; it completes a special trial.

pages.title: Heart of Death
pages.text: In $(l:beginning/spirit_form)Spirit Form$(/l), click with the heart in hand to absorb it. The ability is permanent.
